class.name: MotionRule
class.brief_description: Editable settings for neutral or grounded movement.
class.description: A mover takes a snapshot when you attach or call [method Mover.use_rule]. Multiple bodies can share a resource and retain independent runtime state. Use [method Locomotion.ground] to start with grounded movement.

method.name: get_gravity_scale
method.description: Read the multiplier for grounded gravity.

method.name: get_jump_speed
method.description: Read the grounded takeoff speed in metres per second. Zero disables jumping.

method.name: is_grounded
method.description: Return whether this rule constrains steering to the body's support plane and applies gravity.

method.name: set_gravity_scale
method.description: Set a finite, nonnegative multiplier for the gravity vector supplied by the body. An invalid value leaves the previous multiplier in place.

method.name: set_grounded
method.description: Enable or disable support-plane steering and gravity. Enable this for bodies using grounded [CharacterBody3D] motion.

method.name: set_jump_speed
method.description: Set a finite takeoff speed from 0 to 1000 metres per second. An invalid value leaves the previous speed in place.

members.member: Ground steering acceleration in metres per second squared, from 0 to 1000. Zero removes steering acceleration. [member air_control] scales this value in the air. Invalid values leave the previous value in place.

Fraction of steering acceleration available while airborne, from 0 to 1. Zero preserves existing horizontal momentum until collision. One applies full steering acceleration. Invalid values leave the previous value in place.

Base ground braking rate in metres per second squared when input requests a lower speed or stops. Accepts 0 to 1000. Zero leaves only friction to brake. Invalid values leave the previous value in place.
Multiplier for the body's gravity projected onto its up axis. Applies only when [member grounded] is enabled. Set to zero to keep grounded steering without gravity.
Constrain steering to the plane perpendicular to the body's up axis and apply gravity along that axis. Requires a [CharacterBody3D] in grounded motion mode.
Ground turning and braking coefficient in inverse seconds, from 0 to 100. Higher values redirect momentum and increase speed-dependent braking. Invalid values leave the previous value in place.
Upward takeoff speed in metres per second. Applies to a grounded jump on floor contact. Set to zero to disable jumps.
